issues: 浅灰底 + 中号「ON THE BEAT」+ 三张灰色骨架卡，像线框图，不像印刷品
错版是黑 + 灰，叠出来像投影；四拍除了错位大小外画面没有任何推进
底部节拍点只有十几像素，静音时几乎读不出节拍
拍与拍之间完全静止，节拍之间没有蓄力，命中显得突兀
changes: 配色 custom：再生纸 + riso 荧光橙 × 青绿两色油墨，两版套准叠成墨绿，错开时一侧橙边一侧青边（和 A 式的粉 × 蓝区分开）
版式做成唱片 B 面封套：左侧 196px 黑体标题逐拍盖上一个词 ONE / MORE / TIME, / LOUDER.，每一拍既是冲击也是一句话的推进；右侧 720px 半调网点巨型拍号 1→4 同帧换数
底部改为四格步进音序器：命中格被橙版填满常驻，未到的词半透明预告；青绿播放头在拍前 6f ease-in 加速扑向下一格，正好落在鼓点上
错版加码调到单版 5/9/14/20px（总分离 10/18/28/40px，匹配大字号）；整画面泵 1.08 指数回落、错版只作用标题的作用域不变
开场 0–29f 有预备：版线展开、节拍格错峰浮现、播放头带预备回拉滑进第 1 格、拍号区露出空心「1」；末拍后 24f 真静止
issuesEn: Light grey with a mid-size "ON THE BEAT" and three grey skeleton cards: it looked like a wireframe, not print
The plates were black and grey, which read as a drop shadow; apart from the offset size, nothing progressed across the four beats
The beat dots at the bottom were a dozen pixels wide, so the beat was barely readable with the sound off
Everything froze between beats, with no build-up, so each hit felt abrupt
changesEn: Custom palette: recycled paper with fluorescent orange and teal riso inks; in register they multiply to an inky green, out of register they leave an orange fringe on one side and teal on the other (kept distinct from style A's pink and blue)

Laid out as a record B-side sleeve: a 196px headline on the left gains one word per beat, ONE / MORE / TIME, / LOUDER., so every hit both punches and advances the sentence; a 720px halftone beat numeral on the right changes 1 to 4 on the same frame

The bottom is now a four-step sequencer: hit cells fill with the orange plate and stay lit, upcoming words show at low opacity as a preview, and a teal playhead accelerates (ease-in) into the next cell over the 6f before each beat, landing exactly on it
Offsets tuned to 5/9/14/20px per plate (10/18/28/40px total) to match the larger type; the 1.08 full-frame pump with exponential decay and the title-only offset scope are unchanged

The 0–29f pre-roll now has anticipation: rules extend, beat cells fade up in a stagger, the playhead slides into cell 1 with a pull-back, and a hollow "1" waits in the numeral slot; 24f of true stillness after the last beat
